name: com.cifrasoft.services.AudioHybridSearchSoundCodeService
description: When an app binds ACTV8’s combined audio-search Service and starts a search, it repeatedly checks microphone samples against local and online audio fingerprints and also looks for ACTV8 sound codes.
disableEffect: ACTV8 audio and sound-code triggers will no longer be recognized, so features that depend on them will stop.
